tweet_summary: A short joke caption ('They playing 143 on blast at this kfc') over a clearly AI-generated clip showing a person freefalling off a skyscraper down a giant glass slide labelled with KFC branding — shared as absurdist humor, not as a real event.
why_note_decision: The video is unmistakably AI-generated and the tweet is a joke; reply after reply identifies it as AI ('only in an AI generated video', 'niggas just AI generate anything', 'Garbage AI video'). There is no checkable misleading claim — the author makes no claim that this is real, and the audience overwhelmingly understands it isn't. Original note's effort to debunk the 'KFC skyscraper slide' is fact-checking a joke that no one believed.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The tweet is a one-line joke over an obvious-AI clip; comments consistently identify it as AI. Any note 'debunking' the slide as fake (or the KFC element as nonexistent) is a false positive — the post makes no claim that this is a real KFC, slide, or event.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Misleading — the clip shows an extreme glass skyscraper slide, which are paid tourist attractions like LA's OUE SkySlide. Similar videos have been AI-generated, and there are no KFC locations with high-rise glass slides. Sources: https://abcnews.go.com/Lifestyle/introducing-skyslide-glass-slide-1000-feet-air/story?id=40171035 https://app.kling-ai.com/global/ai-video/dubai-slide-extreme-descent-skyscrapers/296056211314789
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Debunks a joke nobody believed; hedges ('similar videos have been AI-generated') instead of stating it; cites a real LA tourist attraction that just confuses readers. Raters tagged 'note not needed', 'missing key points', and 'hard to understand'.

fact_check.claim_verdict: obvious joke + obvious AI video; no genuine factual claim about reality is made
fact_check.notes: AI-generated KFC content went viral earlier in 2025; the video here is consistent with that. Replies treat it as AI throughout. Nothing factual to correct.

importance.lens_rationale: Trivial viral joke; no policy/safety/welfare stakes. AI-media-literacy angle exists but this specific case is so obvious it teaches nothing.
